## Scope and owner requirement

Parent #344; M7.P5. The owner asks to resolve every discovered gap before the next device builds, clarifying: “Also, my last message said, "any caps we…" but I meant "any gaps"”.

Perform a bounded Epic audit of the post-#540 component/proxy/information/qualification delta from distribution bc2dceb406969a401d987de168acfb3ae60b7e01 to b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe. Firmware is frozen at1a026648442321609b2288c2c9c06803817f9df2; later changes are host tools/evidence. Review #528 engineering input changes, #541–#552 fixes and the interactions with preserved offline achievements, cloud state, startup, clean install and retained upgrades. #540 remains completed; do not replay its transfer.

Scope: one issue chain under #344, Epic. Depth: independent, two model perspectives, OpenAI/Codex primary (exact served SKU unavailable) and pinned Anthropic Fable5.1/xhigh via OpenRouter Facilitator. One refutation call after primary phases1–4.5. No five-seat council or release-wide audit claim. External transfer authorization is separately recorded for this new packet before dispatch.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Existing exact-image runtime receipts and bounded local host/namespace controls cover this delta; newly necessary reproductions use disposable VMs/local backends. No personal account, handheld or cloud operation is required.

The pre-existing #528 publication licence/vendor/source/retrieval/off-host-custody work and #265/#337/#359 release gates remain tracked scope, not invented audit findings. This audit does not allocate an RC or authorize publication.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Frozen source, issue contract, applicable rules, prior-review provenance and independent primary evidence cover every in-scope criterion; at least two randomly selected prior PASS claims are re-derived before Epic consolidation.
- [x] Primary phases1–4.5 record forward verification, interaction/conformance review, attempted refutation and an explicit coverage boundary; no unsupported runtime PASS.
- [ ] The authorized cross-lab refutation uses the Facilitator with successful identity/outcome/digest verification; every reviewer lead is adjudicated from primary artifacts.
- [ ] Punch-list artifacts and issue are created, every finding has a command-verified resolution, required lint passes and exact completion/tracker receipts are retained before audit completion.

## Current evidence — 2026-10-11

Primary phases1–4.5 are complete in `docs/audits/2026_10_11-epic-553-post-review-344/`:44 PASS,5 PARTIAL (existing #528 publication scope), no confirmed new defect. Proof01 ended0 at20:57:18UTC and its process has exited:13 recipe checks,9 pair controls,7 readiness controls,13 optional-information controls,4 ASan lifetime routes,12 fixed proxy checks with one intentionally failing negative control. Random prior545/541 claims were re-derived from sealed actual artifacts. This does not claim fresh VM re-execution; complete clean/retained image20 receipts are source-bound inputs.

Phase4.6 is prepared, not dispatched. One exact1,130,307-byte packet SHA256 `cec44a71f013ddac431b149ee54c356cad2c782baa7dcb35952a17c568dcb256` awaits new named transfer approval. Both existing credential and wordlist scans pass. Prepared owner `/workspace/tmp/pix553-fable01` locally verifies packet/source/ES/tool hashes and requires a matching approval receipt before the Facilitator can run. No background audit call is active. The primary session will consume watcher completion and verify model, effort, response digest and outcome, then adjudicate every lead before Phase5.
title: M7.P5: Audit post-review component and qualification changes
